xna-type.name: DynamicIndexBuffer
xna-type.summary: Describes the rendering order of the vertices in a vertex buffer. Use DynamicIndexBuffer for storing indices for dynamic vertices and IndexBuffer for indices of non-dynamic arrays.
xna-type.remarks: For more information on drawing with dynamic buffers, see DynamicVertexBuffer Class .
